chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 06 (FBISE Past Board Papers Focus 2019–2024)
subject: biology-10

questions.question: What is the normal breathing rate of a healthy adult human at rest? (FBISE Past Paper 2020, 2023)
questions.explanation: Under normal resting basal conditions, a healthy adult breathes at a rate of 12 to 20 cycles per minute.

questions.question: The structural and functional unit of the human kidney is the: (FBISE Past Paper 2019, 2022)
questions.explanation: The nephron is the microscopic functional unit comprising Bowman capsule, convoluted tubules, and loop of Henle.

questions.question: Which muscle sheet forms the floor of the chest cavity and contracts during inspiration? (FBISE Past Paper 2021)
questions.explanation: The muscular diaphragm contracts downward during inspiration, increasing thoracic volume and drawing air into lungs.

questions.question: The master endocrine gland that directs other hormonal glands in the body is the: (FBISE Past Paper 2020, 2024)
questions.explanation: The pituitary gland secretes tropic hormones that orchestrate the activity of the thyroid, adrenal cortex, and gonads.

questions.question: In a monohybrid cross of heterozygous pea plants (Tt x Tt), what is the expected F2 phenotypic ratio? (FBISE Past Paper 2019, 2023)
questions.explanation: According to Mendelian segregation, selfing F1 heterozygotes yields a 3:1 phenotypic ratio (3 tall : 1 dwarf).

questions.question: Which gas in tobacco smoke binds irreversibly with hemoglobin to form carboxyhemoglobin? (FBISE Past Paper 2022)
questions.explanation: Carbon monoxide binds tightly to hemoglobin, impairing cellular oxygen transport throughout tissues.

questions.question: The U-shaped loop of the renal tubule that creates a hypertonic medullary gradient is the: (FBISE Past Paper 2021)
questions.explanation: The loop of Henle establishes an osmotic gradient via countercurrent multiplier action to concentrate urine.

questions.question: Freely movable ball-and-socket joints are anatomically present in which locations? (FBISE Past Paper 2023)
questions.explanation: Ball-and-socket joints at the shoulder and hip permit omnidirectional rotational movement.

questions.question: Which enzyme functions as molecular glue in genetic engineering to seal recombinant DNA backbones? (FBISE Past Paper 2024)
questions.explanation: DNA ligase catalyzes phosphodiester bond formation between adjacent DNA fragments.

questions.question: The clinical condition in which an individual requires increasing doses of a drug to produce the same effect is: (FBISE Past Paper 2020)
questions.explanation: Drug tolerance develops through desensitization of target receptors or accelerated clearance pathways.

questions.question: Which symbiotic relationship benefits both interacting species simultaneously? (FBISE Past Paper 2022)
questions.explanation: In mutualism, both species experience positive fitness and survival benefits from their co-existence.

questions.question: The first clinical antibiotic discovered by Sir Alexander Fleming was: (FBISE Past Paper 2019, 2024)
questions.explanation: Penicillin was discovered by Fleming in 1928 from Penicillium notatum fungal mold.
